description: Zenodo publishes GLRSED V1.2, a global compilation of the surface extents of about 2.17 million lakes and reservoirs. The repository lists Shapefile ZIP archives, including a continent-split option, and a README under the Open Database Licence (ODbL) with free public access. Polygon attributes include names, area, water-body type and source. The team integrated several existing lake and reservoir inventories to improve coverage and spatial consistency. These boundaries can identify storage features, water-supply sources and flood pathways in regional infrastructure simulations. They are mapped surface footprints, not storage-volume curves, dam-condition records or a continuously updated water level series. Underlying source ages and mapping methods vary, so an individual reservoir outline should be checked against its simulation date. The ODbL terms require attention when redistributing adapted databases. GLRSED is distinct from data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs and data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database because it integrates multiple source inventories into a new extent product. No Shapefile archive was downloaded.
